Read `AGENTS.md` in the repository root before making any change. It lists the
generated files that must never be edited by hand, and the rules that keep this
site free to run.

The short version: content lives in `content/` and is uploaded by the artist.
Everything under `app/projects/items/`, `app/about.mdx`, `app/usage.json` and
`public/_web/` is regenerated on every build and your edits there will vanish.
